t2.title: The voting age be lowered to 16
t2.prompt: A student magazine announced an article writing contest. The best ones will be published in the magazine. Write your article on this topic: "Should the voting age be lowered to 16?" Write 180–200 words, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample:
The debate about lowering the voting age to 16 has gained attention in many countries. I believe this change would be beneficial for democracy.

Firstly, 16-year-olds are already trusted with significant responsibilities. They can work, pay taxes, and in some countries, join the military. If society considers them mature enough for these duties, they should have a say in choosing their government.

Secondly, political decisions deeply affect young people's futures, from education policies to climate change. Allowing them to vote would ensure their concerns are represented and encourage politicians to address youth issues.

Moreover, voting at 16 could establish lifelong civic engagement. Research suggests that people who vote young are more likely to continue voting throughout their lives.

However, opponents argue that teenagers lack the knowledge and maturity to make informed decisions. This concern could be addressed by improving political education in schools.

In conclusion, lowering the voting age would strengthen democracy by including young voices and creating more engaged citizens. The benefits outweigh the potential drawbacks.

t2.sampleB2: Old Enough to Vote? Every few years, the same question pops up: should teenagers be allowed to vote at 16? It's a topic that gets people fired up, and I believe the answer is a firm yes. To begin with, 16-year-olds already carry real responsibilities. Many of them hold down part-time jobs, pay taxes and help run their households. If they are trusted to do all this, surely they deserve a say in who runs the country. What's more, the decisions politicians make today — on education, jobs and the environment — will shape young people's lives for decades. Letting them vote means their voices finally count, and it pushes leaders to take their concerns seriously rather than brushing them aside. Of course, some argue that teenagers aren't mature enough to make sensible choices. However, this could easily be tackled by teaching politics properly in schools, so that first-time voters know exactly what they are voting for. All things considered, lowering the voting age would breathe new life into democracy and turn young people into active citizens early on. Giving them the vote would send a clear message that their opinions truly matter.
t2.uzSample:
Ko'plab mamlakatlarda ovoz berish yoshini 16 yoshga tushirish haqidagi bahs-munozaralar e'tiborni tortdi. Menimcha, bu o'zgarish demokratiya uchun foydali bo'ladi.

Birinchidan, 16 yoshli o'smirlarga allaqachon muhim mas'uliyatlar yuklatilgan. Ular ishlashi, soliq to'lashi va ba'zi mamlakatlarda armiyaga qo'shilishi mumkin. Agar jamiyat ularni bu vazifalar uchun yetarlicha yetuk deb hisoblasa, ularning hukumatni tanlashda o'z so'ziga ega bo'lishi kerak.

Ikkinchidan, siyosiy qarorlar yoshlarning kelajagiga ta'lim siyosatidan tortib iqlim o'zgarishigacha chuqur ta'sir qiladi. Ularga ovoz berishga ruxsat berish ularning tashvishlari ifodalanishini ta'minlaydi va siyosatchilarni yoshlar muammolariga e'tibor qaratishga undaydi.

Bundan tashqari, 16 yoshda ovoz berish umrbod fuqarolik faolligini o'rnatishi mumkin. Tadqiqotlar shuni ko'rsatadiki, yoshligida ovoz bergan odamlar hayoti davomida ovoz berishni davom ettirish ehtimoli ko'proq.

Biroq, opponentlar o'smirlarda asosli qarorlar qabul qilish uchun bilim va yetuklik yetishmasligini ta'kidlaydilar. Bu xavotirni maktablarda siyosiy ta'limni yaxshilash orqali hal qilish mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, ovoz berish yoshini tushirish yoshlarning ovozini qo'shish va yanada faol fuqarolarni yaratish orqali demokratiyani mustahkamlaydi. Foydalari potentsial kamchiliklardan ustun turadi.

Hurmat bilan,
Akmal Xolmatov

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the online store. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear TrendyStyle Customer Care, Thank you for reaching out regarding my recent shopping experience with your online store. I was genuinely pleased with the quality of the items I ordered. The dress and jacket matched the website photos accurately, and the sizes were true to the measurements provided. The delivery arrived within three days, which exceeded my expectations. However, I would like to suggest some improvements. Firstly, the return process could be simplified by including a prepaid return label in the package. Secondly, offering a virtual try-on feature using phone cameras would help customers choose sizes more confidently. I was also slightly disappointed that the tracking information was not updated frequently enough during shipping. Overall, I am satisfied with my purchase and will shop with you again. Yours sincerely, Akmal Xolmatov

On the whole, I was very pleased with my purchase. The clothes matched the pictures on your website almost perfectly, and the sizes were spot on. My order arrived within two days, and the packaging was neat and secure, so nothing was damaged in transit. That said, there are a few things you could improve. Firstly, it would be helpful to include a prepaid return label in every parcel, as sending items back is currently rather awkward. Secondly, adding customer reviews with photos would give shoppers a clearer idea of how each item actually looks. Overall, I am a satisfied customer and will happily shop with you again.
